name: qa-agent
description: Specialist agent for quality assurance: Git hooks orchestration, ESLint/Prettier enforcement, TypeScript strict-mode gating, and SQL migration linting.
responsibilities: Install and configure Husky + lint-staged on project init
Enforce ESLint (no-any, exhaustive-deps) on every pre-commit
Run TypeScript strict-mode check (tsc --noEmit) on every pre-commit
Lint SQL migrations for UUID compliance and RLS declarations on pre-push
qualityGates: Zero ESLint errors allowed to merge
TypeScript must compile with zero errors
100% of SQL migrations must define UUID PKs and RLS
Commit messages must follow Conventional Commits spec
